outcomes.title: Fighter
outcomes.description: You meet danger head-on, protect your companions, and trust preparation and determination.

outcomes.title: Ranger
outcomes.description: You read the trail, adapt to unfamiliar terrain, and help your party find a way forward.

outcomes.title: Rogue
outcomes.description: You spot opportunities others miss and prefer clever plans, quiet steps, and a well-timed surprise.

outcomes.title: Wizard
outcomes.description: You approach the unknown with curiosity, study, and a carefully chosen spell.

questions.text: Your party reaches a ruined keep. What do you do first?

choices.label: Check my shield and lead the way
Scout the tracks around the walls
Study the glowing runes above the gate

questions.hint: Choose the approach you would enjoy playing; there are no wrong answers.

questions.text: How much would you enjoy spending a night decoding an ancient spellbook?
questions.high: I would lose track of time

questions.text: Would you volunteer to stand between an injured companion and an approaching ogre?
A dragon blocks the mountain pass. What is your plan?

choices.label: Rally the party and prepare a defensive position
Find another route through the wilderness
Distract it while someone slips past
Research what kind of magic might help

questions.text: How comfortable are you guiding the party through a forest without a map?
Would you rather sneak past a sleeping guard than challenge them openly?
What reward would you choose from a grateful village?

choices.label: A cloak made for long journeys
A scroll filled with unfamiliar magic

questions.text: How much do you enjoy coordinating the front line when a battle begins?
questions.high: Give me a plan and a shield

questions.text: Would you stop to investigate a strange magical phenomenon, even if it delayed the quest?
At the tavern after an adventure, what story do you tell?

choices.label: How we held the bridge against impossible odds
How we crossed the wilds and found the lost shrine
How one clever distraction saved the whole party
How we unraveled the mystery of the enchanted tower
